methods.database: SQLite URI mode=ro; immutable=1 only for stopped databases with no WAL. Batch 4 uses before-app.db saved before later UI reopening. No product, model, test, task resume, or database write was performed.
methods.amendment: Join bot_messages.message_id = work_intent_snapshots.source_message_id. Select changed revision and exact Work binding. First actual tool means minimum task_tool_diagnostics.started_at for the new binding task_id; admission is independently recorded in work_action_admissions.
methods.artifactDelivery: Join bot_work_feedback with bot_messages. Count only file refs matching work_generated_artifacts.snapshotPath for that exact Work and matching current SHA-256/size. A message may contain additional unregistered working-path refs: retain them, but they do not establish an immutable artifact delivery. Times are persisted application timestamps, not SQLite commit or GUI paint.
methods.transportAttribution: First require a unique diagnostic within 0..1000 ms before transport request, end time within 10 ms, and exact completion_tokens plus prompt_tokens = diagnostic input+cacheRead+cacheWrite. Otherwise retain only a unique +/-100 ms start match. Associations must be injective. Structured raw review originalRequest.workId identifies review ownership directly.
methods.toolCount: Count unique persisted diagnostic callId across task_tool_diagnostics and scope_tool_diagnostics, including failed/cancelled tools. Compare separately with unique callId visible in later model request transcripts.
methods.stageBoundary: Foreground, native main execution, native subagent, ordinary completion review and watch result review are distinguishable. Native summary and observation model stages are not independently instrumented; null means unknown, never zero.

limits: No new performance samples; no new P95, SLA, monetary price, screen paint, input-to-visible, or SQLite commit claim.
A failed or partial result with a valid artifact is an available artifact delivery, not a successful overall outcome. Ongoing goals have no final completion time.
Request-to-result for scheduled/event work includes deliberate waiting for due time or source changes; it is not processing latency.
Matching diagnostics to HTTP by time and token evidence is posthoc correlation, not a propagated request-ID trace. Unknown or ambiguous requests remain unknown.
Neither a persisted failed tool nor a stopped binding proves that no side effects occurred.
Summary and observation may occur inside native execution generations; do not sum independent invented stages.

Current-byte validation proves preserved snapshots still match their recorded digest; unregistered working-path refs cannot prove the bytes available at the historical message time and are excluded from eligible snapshot counts.

First verified artifact means only a registered immutable file was included in a persisted message; a status report is not a completed benchmark. The event goals also expose the first benchmark.json delivery separately.
